about.title: AI music you can actually use
about.lead: AVIBE is a streaming and licensing platform that only publishes AI music whose commercial-use rights have been checked. We build music distribution that listeners, creators and businesses can all rely on.
mission: AI-generated music is growing fast, but whether a track can be played in a store or used in a video is still unclear. Every generator has different terms, free and paid plans grant different rights, and the same track can be registered in several places.

Before a track goes public, AVIBE checks the generator, the subscription window, file integrity and duplicates, and attaches a per-track certificate only to tracks that pass. So for every AVIBE track you can always see who made it, when, and under which terms.

principles.d: Tracks whose commercial-use terms we cannot confirm stay unpublished. When in doubt, we keep it closed.
We say "commercial-use rights verified", never "100% guaranteed". Certificates only state what we checked.
Creators receive 70% of net distribution revenue, and the dashboard shows the basis of every payout.

We match the generation time against the paid subscription window.
SHA-256 hashes and audio fingerprints are compared with existing tracks.
After a final admin review, a unique per-track certificate is issued.

items.a: Yes. After signing up you can stream every verified track in standard quality (128kbps) for free and create unlimited playlists. High quality (256kbps) and downloads require a pass.

items.q: Can I listen without an account?
items.a: Anyone can browse tracks, details and certificates. Playback requires signing in so we can confirm you are 14 or older and have accepted the terms.
Use "Forgot password" on the login screen and enter your email. We will send a reset link that expires after a while.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: Go to Account settings > Privacy. Personal data such as your email and name is destroyed immediately; only settlement and tax records required by law are kept anonymously. You can export your data first.
No. A pass is a one-month pass with no auto-billing. Pay again only when you need it.

Within 7 days of payment and with no usage (no play over 30 seconds and no download) you get a full refund. Otherwise, cancelling immediately refunds the remainder after deducting the days used, with no penalty.
In Account settings > Billing, choose "Cancel at period end" or "Cancel now" (you will see the refund amount first).
Payments are processed in the Toss Payments window, with cards and easy-pay options. AVIBE never stores card details.

It means we checked that the track was generated within a paid plan's subscription window of an allowed AI platform, that the file was not altered, and that it does not duplicate an existing track. The evidence is recorded in the per-track certificate.

items.q: How do I check a certificate?
items.a: Tap the verified badge on a track page, or enter a certificate number starting with AVB- on the certificate lookup page. Anyone can verify it.

items.q: Can I use tracks in a store or a video?
items.a: Store BGM and video background music are available under a business license. Send an inquiry and we will suggest terms for your use and scale.
Suno, Udio, AIVA, Stable Audio, ElevenLabs, commercially licensed open models, and AVIBE's own model. See the AI models page for each platform's conditions.

items.q: What do I need to upload?
items.a: A creator account, a verified email, and proof of a paid subscription to the AI platform you used. A license pre-check shows whether a track will pass before you upload.

Creators receive 70% of net distribution revenue. Free plays by general listeners are not settled; store plays and direct sales or license revenue are. Payouts are made after business (3.3%) or other income (8.8%) withholding.

Tracks from free or trial plans, tracks made outside the subscription window, non-commercial models, duplicates and files with non-commercial metadata are rejected. The reason appears in your studio review history.

items.q: I found a track that infringes my work.
items.a: Report it through the Rights center or "Report infringement" on the track page. The track is hidden immediately, and after the uploader's counter-notice process we let you know the outcome.

items.q: I want to restore my reported track.
items.a: Submit a counter-notice from your studio. An admin reviews both sides and decides.

models.title: Which AI-made tracks we accept
models.lead: AVIBE checks commercial-use terms separately for each generator. Only tracks that meet the conditions below are published and certified.
models.basis: Policy as of 2026-11-11 · updated when a platform's terms change.
common: SHA-256 file integrity and duplicate detection
FFprobe metadata analysis (blocks non-commercial and trial markers)
Final admin review with a stored policy snapshot
A unique per-track certificate with public verification

avibe.summary: The generation model AVIBE runs itself. Every output must pass watermarking and a similarity check before it goes public (Born Verified).
accepted: Based on ACE-Step 1.5 (MIT-licensed code and weights)
Passes a similarity pre-check against existing tracks
rejected: Prompts asking for a real artist's name or voice clone
Requests to imitate a specific singer's or song's style
Outputs without a watermark or similarity result
notes: A five-language prompt guard blocks banned requests up front
Three banned requests in 24 hours pause generation
Model version, seed and weights hash are kept in the generation record

suno.summary: We accept tracks generated on a paid Suno plan.
accepted: Generated during a Pro or Premier subscription
rejected: Free, Basic or trial plan output
Generated before the subscription started or after it expired
notes: Uploads open after an admin verifies the subscription proof
Generation time is matched against the subscription window

udio.summary: Only tracks generated on a paid Udio plan before downloads were discontinued.
accepted: Generated during a Standard or Pro subscription
rejected: Free, Basic or trial plan output
notes: A cutoff applies from the date downloads stopped
Generation time is matched against the subscription window

aiva.summary: Only AIVA Pro output, where copyright belongs to the creator.
notes: Sync-only plans cannot be distributed as standalone streams

stable-audio.summary: We accept tracks generated with a paid Stable Audio membership.
accepted: Solo, Session, Producer, Studio, Pro or Enterprise output
notes: The open-weights Stable Audio Open is non-commercial and blocked separately

elevenlabs.summary: We accept tracks generated on a paid ElevenLabs Music plan.
accepted: Generated during a Creator or higher paid subscription
rejected: Free, Starter or trial plan output
Tracks marked as AI covers or voice clones

open-model.summary: We accept tracks made with open models under licenses that allow commercial use.
accepted: Apache-2.0, MIT or commercially licensed models
rejected: MusicGen, AudioGen, MusicLM, Stable Audio Open
notes: The model name and license are declared at upload

soundraw.summary: Not accepted at this time. Composition copyright stays with Soundraw, so the creator-ownership requirement is not met.
notes: We will review again if the terms change

mubert.summary: Not accepted at this time. The license prohibits standalone streaming distribution.
notes: We will review again if the terms change
